text_block_list.text: Running errand at shopping mall when crowd caught my attention.

Sign mentioned new product launch. 
Apparently special guest scheduled to appear——

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
——Hm? 
……Why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Right. My family shares long history with this brand.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Appearing in promotions, assisting product development. 
Same for this new release.

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text: Duramente-san! Ready for prep~?

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah, as expected of Duramente-san! 
New sneakers look great on you!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to today's talk! Eager 
to hear insights from prestigious family, 
especially on sports theory and training!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……Understood. Looking forward to working with you.

Polite response to staff's high expectations…… 
Yet her posture remained tense, guarded.
choice_data_list: Since I'm here, I'll listen too

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……Do as you please.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san's family participated throughout 
development of these high-tech sneakers. 
Could you share your thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Priority was reducing strain on runner's legs. 
Sole structure required extensive refinement.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
For active competitor like Duramente-san, 
minimizing leg stress is crucial issue, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Wearing these regularly to condition legs 
should enhance performance on turf, right?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Design tailored strictly to runner needs. 
Product's true worth——I shall prove on turf.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Oooh~! High hopes indeed! 
For Duramente-san's races, and subsequent sales!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your hard work today!
choice_data_list: Dura, good work! Heading back now?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
——No, heading to gym now. 
Need to test new training equipment.

Surprised by packed schedule…… 
Curious about new machine too, decided to tag along.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
There. Hack Squat machine. 
Must evaluate ergonomics and load distribution——

text_block_list.name: Gym Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, isn't that Duramente-san……?

text_block_list.name: Gym Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Rumors of her training here were real…… 
Here to test new rig, right?
choice_data_list: You really do get noticed a lot
You really do get noticed a lot

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
……Used to attention. 
Testing machine after warm-up.
Concerned about condition, watched over warm-ups……

text_block_list.name: Gym Bro
text_block_list.text: What kind of numbers will Duramente put up……?
Fingers turning pale, gripping hard. This is——

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (……Not good. Muscles locking up——)
choice_data_list: How about starting over with stretches?
How about starting over with stretches?

text_block_list.text:
Heavy gaze of onlookers, crushing expectations. 
Tension inevitable under that spotlight.
choice_data_list: You can try putting in earphones too

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……Right.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Phew……! Phew……!

text_block_list.name: Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
Insane, look at that weight load…… 
How much more is she adding……!

text_block_list.name: Gym Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's watch! Want to see gap 
between ordinary Uma Musume and real elite!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
——Hah.
Fuu——…………

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ——……Tremors stopped.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
……Nothing, talking to myself. 
One more set.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Fuu——…………Haa! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haaaa——!

text_block_list.name: Gym Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
——Whoa, still pushing? 
Power output and stamina on whole different level……!

text_block_list.name: Gym Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Duramente truly is incredible……!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
……Adequate. Solid resistance curve, good biomechanics. 
Worth integrating into routine.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……Seems you accompanied me entire time.

Valuable day observing routine outside track. 
Gym session especially productive.

Training resumes tomorrow. 
Motivation renewed to support her all way.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes——

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: …………Baffling person.
